generatedProceduralAssets.description: High-resolution architectural and metallurgical blueprint illustrating the 4 stages of punch-cutting (Counter-punch, cold-displacement strike, graver filing with 9° draft angle, copper matrix strike), the full oxidation temper color spectrum (200°C to 300°C), and Fred Smeijers' counter-punch sharing matrix across lowercase b, d, p, q.

midjourneyPrompts.title: Plate 1 (16th-Century Punch-Cutter's Vise & Counter-Punches)
midjourneyPrompts.prompt: Extreme macro photography of Claude Garamond's 16th-century typographic atelier in Paris: an iron bench vise clamps a rectangular annealed tool steel blank, beside it sits an array of hardened steel counter-punches with razor-sharp micro-relief glyph tips, a heavy brass mallet, fine jewelers needle files, iron shavings on dark weathered oak workbench, raking candle and north window light, Hasselblad H6D-100c, 8k resolution --ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6.1

midjourneyPrompts.title: Plate 2 (Cherry-Red Heat Quench & Temper Colors)
midjourneyPrompts.prompt: Authentic blacksmith forge metallurgy for letterpress punch-cutting: a master punch-cutter holds a glowing cherry-red steel punch with tongs above a quenching barrel of cold water, steam hissing into the air, on the anvil a polished tempered steel punch displays shimmering oxide colors of pale straw yellow, bronze, and peacock blue, dramatic dark chiaroscuro lighting, 8k --ar 4:3 --style raw --v 6.1

videoMotionBlueprints.title: Sequence Alpha (Counter-Punch Hammer Strike & Plastic Steel Squeeze)
videoMotionBlueprints.toolTarget: Runway Gen-3 / OpenAI Sora / Google Veo
videoMotionBlueprints.prompt: Cinematic 1000fps ultra-slow-motion macro video of a brass hammer striking a hardened steel counter-punch: The tip drives 0.8mm into the face of an annealed steel blank, cold-displacing glowing microscopic shear lines as solid steel plastically flows like stiff clay, forging the perfect inner negative bowl of a lowercase letter e, 4k.
